| On/off-ramp | Provider URL discovery | `src/api/methods/other.ts:127-156` |

These features require the original Brilliant/backend contracts or a new backend implementing the same request, authentication, response, rate-limit and error semantics.

### 5.3 OPTIONAL / protocol / navigation services

| Origin/service | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `https://tonconnectbridge.mytonwallet.org/bridge/` | TonConnect SSE bridge |
| `https://analytics.ton.org` | TonConnect analytics; events are sent to `/events` |
| `https://*.walletconnect.com`, `https://*.walletconnect.org` | WalletConnect relay/bridge allowlists |
| `https://api.pay.walletconnect.com`, `https://api.pay.walletconnect.org` | WalletConnect Pay APIs |
| `https://pay.walletconnect.com` | WalletConnect Pay frame |
| `https://analytics.ton.org` | TonConnect analytics |
| `https://ipfs.io/ipfs/` | IPFS gateway |
| `https://static.mytonwallet.org` | Cards and static assets |
| `https://imgproxy.mytonwallet.org` | Image proxy allowed by CSP |
| `https://dns-image.mytonwallet.org` | TON DNS image service |
| Original S3/static URLs | Desktop update feed and product assets |
| Tonscan, Tonviewer, Getgems, Solscan, Magic Eden, Etherscan, OpenSea, Basescan, BscScan, Polygonscan | User navigation/explorer links, not core API clients |

### 5.4 Original My Wallet infrastructure

The following namespaces are product-owned/original infrastructure, not neutral third-party endpoints:

```text
*.mywallet.io
*.mytonwallet.org
*.mytonwallet.io
```

This includes Brilliant backend/proxy, TON RPC/indexer proxies, Tron/Solana/EVM gateways, portfolio, Agent, MFA, static CDN, multisend and TonConnect bridge.

The fork must make an explicit decision for every such dependency:

1. retain it with permission and compatible production policy;
2. replace it with a self-hosted/owned service;
3. remove/disable the dependent feature;
4. keep it only as a temporary migration dependency.

## 6. `api.mywallet.io/referrer/get` call chain

The reported request failure is not the wallet key/custody path.

1. `createDirectApiConnector().initApi()` starts initialization in `src/api/providers/direct/connector.ts:22-28`.
2. `init()` starts polling, transfers, tokens, NFTs, MFA, staking, swap, optional Agent V2 and protocol services in `src/api/methods/init.ts:35-67`.
3. `saveReferrer()` uses an explicit `args.referrer`; otherwise it awaits `fetchBackendReferrer()` in `src/api/methods/init.ts:79-81`.
4. `fetchBackendReferrer()` calls `callBackendGet('/referrer/get')` in `src/api/common/backend.ts:86-88`.
5. The default full URL is `GET https://api.mywallet.io/referrer/get`.
6. `callBackendGet` uses the shared backend transport, app identity headers and retry/timeout behavior from `src/api/common/backend.ts:48-74`.
7. If a referrer is returned, it is persisted in storage under `referrer`, followed by client ID initialization.
8. A separate install-attribution chain calls `POST /attribution/claim` in `src/api/methods/attribution.ts:21-29,65-127`.
9. MFA has a separate query parameter chain: `?r=` is read in `src/mfa/runtime.ts:38-48`.

### Criticality

`/referrer/get` is optional attribution/client-ID initialization. It is not required for:

- local wallet creation;
- seed import;
- local key derivation;
- ordinary receive/address display;
- ordinary locally signed transaction flow, assuming chain APIs are available.

Other `api.mywallet.io` calls are more important: `/assets`, `/currency-rates`, swap, staking, portfolio, notifications and Agent can affect their respective features and loading states.

## 7. TON requirements

### Minimum for a usable TON wallet

1. Toncenter-compatible V3 wallet state endpoint.
2. Jetton wallet/balance endpoint.
3. Actions and pending actions.
4. Raw transactions.
5. NFT ownership/transfers and metadata support.
6. Message broadcast.
7. Transaction emulation.
8. WebSocket activity stream or reliable HTTP polling fallback.
9. Correct `X-Api-Key` and `X-Actions-Version` behavior where required.
10. CORS/CSP/rate limits compatible with browser clients, or an owned proxy.

### Feature mapping

| Function | Required chain service |
|---|---|
| TON balance | `/walletStates` |
| History | `/actions`, `/pendingActions`, `/transactions` |
| Send TON | Local signing + message broadcast; emulation for estimation |
| Receive TON | Local address/QR/invoice UI; indexer needed after receipt |
| Jettons | `/jetton/wallets`, metadata and token catalog |
| NFTs | NFT indexer, item/transfer endpoints, metadata/image gateway |
| Staking | On-chain contracts plus pool catalog/state/profit backend |
| Swap | Backend aggregator/router/build/execute plus chain services |
| Prices | Token catalog, market assets and currency rates backend |
| Emulation | `/api/emulate/v1/emulateTrace` or compatible service |

### Toncenter vs TonAPI

The current code is primarily built around Toncenter-compatible endpoints for wallet state, actions, transactions, NFT data, streaming and emulation. TonAPI-compatible configuration is present for supplemental capabilities/metadata.

They are not drop-in interchangeable solely by changing the base URL:

- response schemas and pagination may differ;
- action and transaction shapes must match the adapter expectations;
- WebSocket/streaming semantics must match;
- emulation endpoint and request format must match;
- headers and API-key behavior must match.

For an independent fork, choose one of:

- maintain a compatible Toncenter-facing proxy;
- adapt the chain modules to a selected provider;
- create an owned backend that normalizes Toncenter/TonAPI/provider responses.

## 8. Telegram Mini App

### Required application configuration

- Build with `IS_TELEGRAM_APP=1`.
- Build with `APP_ENV=production`.
- Set `BASE_URL=https://mytonwallet.shop`.
- Set `BOT_USERNAME` to the actual production bot username.
- Keep Telegram SDK from `https://telegram.org/js/telegram-web-app.js`.
- Preserve `window.Telegram.WebApp` initialization in `src/util/telegram/index.ts`.
- Do not put the Telegram bot token in frontend code.

### BotFather

The production bot must be configured externally:

- Main Mini App URL: `https://mytonwallet.shop`;
- menu button/Mini App URL must use HTTPS;
- bot username must match `BOT_USERNAME`;
- direct launches should use the correct `https://t.me/<bot>?startapp=...` form;
- test `?r=` and start parameters inside Telegram;
- verify Telegram WebApp, orientation, safe area, fullscreen, swipe and biometric behavior.

The repository does not configure BotFather remotely.

### Telegram headers and CSP

Telegram build uses `src/_headers_telegram`, while ordinary web uses `src/_headers`.

Telegram-specific requirements:

- preserve the Telegram CSP response header;
- preserve `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`;
- preserve Telegram framing policy;
- preserve `X-Robots-Tag: noindex`;
- preserve immutable/static asset caching where intended;
- serve CSP as an HTTP response header, not only the `<meta>` tag;
- do not deploy the ordinary `X-Frame-Options: Deny` header for the Telegram Mini App.

`src/_headers_telegram:1` contains a stale comment referring to `tma.mywallet.io`; this is a documentation/configuration gap, not proof that the runtime host is changed.

## 9. TON Connect

Current defaults:

- bridge: `https://tonconnectbridge.mytonwallet.org/bridge/`;
- analytics: `https://analytics.ton.org`;
- protocol v2;
- dApp manifest URL must be HTTPS and origin-consistent;
- multisend manifest currently declares `https://multisend.mywallet.io`.

Required production decisions:

1. Keep the original bridge/analytics with permission, or operate compatible replacements.
2. Host every owned manifest on HTTPS.
3. Keep manifest URL, declared origin and icon URL consistent.
4. Review CSP for bridge, analytics, manifest and icon origins.
5. Test injected/embedded wallet and universal-link flows inside Telegram.
6. If multisend is retained by the fork, migrate its domain and manifest together.

Telegram does not provide TonConnect bridge infrastructure by itself.

## 10. WalletConnect and WalletConnect Pay

### WalletConnect

`WALLET_CONNECT_PROJECT_ID` is read in `src/config.ts:172` and documented in `.env.example:23`. The audit did not find active `Core`/`SignClient` project-ID initialization in the current browser path.

Conclusion:

- Project ID is not demonstrably required by the current build;
- if a future SDK/relay path requires it, register `mytonwallet.shop` as a production origin;
- the Project ID is public;
- WalletConnect Cloud secrets/API credentials are not public and must stay server-side;
- retain only required relay origins in CSP.

### WalletConnect Pay

WalletConnect Pay is implemented in:

- `src/components/walletConnectPay/`;
- `src/api/methods/walletConnectPay.ts`;
- `src/global/actions/api/walletConnectPay.ts`;
- `src/util/walletConnectPay.ts`.

It depends on:

- `WALLET_CONNECT_PROJECT_ID`;
- `WALLET_CONNECT_PAY_APP_ID`;
- `api.pay.walletconnect.com`;
- `api.pay.walletconnect.org`;
- `pay.walletconnect.com`;
- registered Pay/merchant configuration;
- any merchant signing/API credentials kept server-side.

It is not fully self-hostable from this frontend repository.

## 11. Static assets and CDN

The application still references:

- `static.mytonwallet.org`;
- `imgproxy.mytonwallet.org`;
- `dns-image.mytonwallet.org`;
- original S3/update-feed hosts;
- TONAPI image/metadata hosts;
- `ipfs.io/ipfs/`;
- `cards.mytonwallet.io`;
- original promo/legal/blog/site assets.

### What happens if they are unavailable

- core wallet UI may open;
- token/NFT logos and metadata may be missing;
- cards and promotional sections may be broken;
- TON DNS image rendering may fail;
- desktop update checks may fail;
- CSP or image loading may block resources;
- optional features can remain in loading/error states.

Moving the visible site to `mytonwallet.shop` does not automatically migrate these assets. A self-hosted fork needs an explicit CDN/object-storage decision and CSP update.

## 12. Feature infrastructure matrix

| Функция | Работает сейчас в коде | Что отсутствует/зависит от внешних сервисов | Что нужно настроить | Критичность |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Запуск | Да, web/Telegram/Electron/SDK targets | Default API still original infrastructure | Compatible API endpoints, CSP and build values | CRITICAL |
| Создание кошелька | Да, local mnemonic/derivation | Initial balance needs chain API | TON RPC/indexer | CRITICAL |
| Импорт seed/private key/Ledger | Да | Account discovery/backend extras use chain/backend | Compatible chain API; Ledger build support | CRITICAL |
| Баланс TON | Да | Toncenter V3 `/walletStates` | Toncenter-compatible endpoint/key policy | CRITICAL |
| История | Да | Actions/transactions/socket | Indexer, WebSocket or polling | CRITICAL |
| Отправка TON | Да, local signing | Broadcast/emulation; gasless uses backend/payer | Broadcast, emulation; optional gasless backend | CRITICAL |
| Получение TON | Да, local address/QR/invoice | Balance after receipt needs indexer | Chain API | CRITICAL |
| Jettons | Да | Catalog, metadata, prices, scam data use backend | Toncenter-compatible jetton API and token catalog | IMPORTANT |
| NFT | Да | Indexer, metadata/image gateway and optional reporting | NFT API, IPFS/image strategy | IMPORTANT |
| Swap | UI and flow exist | Estimate/build/execute, routing/liquidity, auth backend | New aggregator/backend or retain Brilliant | IMPORTANT |
| Staking | Code exists but extra-feature gated | Pool catalog, state and profit backend | Pool config/contracts/backend | IMPORTANT |
| Token prices | Code exists | `/assets`, `/market/assets`, rates | Price/catalog provider or new backend | IMPORTANT |
| Emulation/estimation | TON/EVM/Solana modules exist | Provider-compatible emulation | Emulation endpoint and chain RPCs | IMPORTANT |
| Portfolio | UI/DApp exists | PnL/net-worth aggregation API | Portfolio API or replacement | OPTIONAL/IMPORTANT |
| TON Connect | Implemented | Bridge, analytics, manifests, CSP | Bridge/manifest/origin policy | IMPORTANT |
| WalletConnect | Adapters exist | Relay/project/origin policy; current Project ID use unclear | Confirm SDK path; register project if required | OPTIONAL/IMPORTANT |
| Telegram Mini App | Runtime/build exists | BotFather, Mini App URL, headers, bot settings | Telegram production configuration | IMPORTANT |
| Agent | V1/V2 surface exists | Agent backend, PostgreSQL, migrations, provider credentials | Self-host Agent backend or retain original | OPTIONAL |
| MFA | Code exists | MFA server, bot, contract, auth | MFA infrastructure or disable by explicit product decision | OPTIONAL/IMPORTANT |
| Referrals | Attribution chain exists | `/referrer/get`, `/attribution/claim` backend | Backend or accept loss of attribution | OPTIONAL |
| Notifications | Subscribe/unsubscribe UI exists | Backend push delivery and device token service | Notification backend/provider | OPTIONAL |
| Giveaway | No implementation found | No source feature/API found | Separate product implementation if required | OUT OF SCOPE |
| Multisend | Separate DApp/build exists | TonConnect, manifests, chain/indexer | Own/retain multisend host and manifest | OPTIONAL/IMPORTANT |
| WalletConnect Pay | UI/protocol flow exists | Pay API, app/merchant config, credentials | WalletConnect Pay account/origins | OPTIONAL |

## 13. Security requirements

### Never put in frontend

- Telegram bot tokens;
- backend auth tokens/signing secrets;
- MFA master/private keys;
- WalletConnect Cloud/API secrets;
- WalletConnect Pay merchant secrets;
- privileged RPC/API keys;
- test mnemonic/password;
- Hostinger API tokens.

### Public values

These are visible to users in bundles and are not secrets by themselves:

- deployment URL;
- bot username;
- API origins;
- WalletConnect Project ID;
- WalletConnect Pay App ID;
- fee/pool/contract addresses;
- feature flags;
- CSP origins.

Public does not mean trusted. Authorization, rate limiting and privileged operations must be enforced server-side.

### Headers and CSP

Review:

- `webpack.config.ts:82-167`;
- `src/_headers`;
- `src/_headers_telegram`;
- `src/index.html:20`.

The HTML CSP meta tag is not a substitute for the HTTP response header. Any Hostinger rewrite/static configuration must preserve the appropriate headers.

## 14. Domain migration map

### Candidate values to migrate if `.shop` becomes canonical

- `PRODUCTION_URL` / `BASE_URL`;
- `BETA_URL` if a beta host is created;
- canonical headers in `webpack.config.ts:579-594`;
- HTML homepage/canonical metadata;
- install/site/icon/promo/legal/blog URLs;
- Telegram Mini App URL;
- owned multisend/portfolio/MFA hosts if actually recreated;
- TonConnect manifests and icon URLs;
- WalletConnect/Pay registered origins;
- BotFather configuration;
- CSP `frame-src`, `connect-src`, `img-src`;
- `IFRAME_WHITELIST` and `SUBPROJECT_URL_MASK`;
- deployment routing and TLS.

### Values not to replace casually

Do not replace these only because the visible website changed:

- blockchain RPC/indexer endpoints that remain external;
- TonConnect bridge/analytics if intentionally retained;
- protocol/deeplink schemes;
- contract/token/fee/pool addresses;
- `GLOBAL_STATE_CACHE_KEY`;
- `LEGACY_APP_HOSTS` unless legacy compatibility is intentionally retired;
- Gram-specific `wallet.ton.org` / `gramwallet.io` values when building My Wallet.

## 15. Final preparation lists

### A. ОБЯЗАТЕЛЬНО УСТАНОВИТЬ/НАСТРОИТЬ

For a basic independent TON wallet:

1. HTTPS hosting and DNS for `mytonwallet.shop`.
2. Production build with correct `BASE_URL`.
3. Compatible TON state, actions, transactions, jetton, NFT, broadcast and emulation services.
4. WebSocket stream or HTTP polling fallback.
5. CSP and security headers.
6. A decision on whether original My Wallet backend/proxy is retained.
7. Telegram Mini App build and BotFather setup if Telegram is a target.
8. Correct Telegram-specific headers for Telegram deployment.
9. Valid TonConnect manifest/origin if TON Connect is a target.
10. No privileged API keys embedded in public bundles.

For the current original-feature parity target, also:

11. Brilliant-compatible backend or a replacement for `/assets`, rates, swap, staking, portfolio, notifications, attribution and Agent.
12. Portfolio aggregation API.
13. Agent backend and provider infrastructure.
14. MFA server/bot/contract setup.
15. WalletConnect/Pay registration and origin policy where used.
16. Static/image/CDN ownership or an explicit decision to retain original services.

### B. НУЖНО ПОЛУЧИТЬ API KEYS / CREDENTIALS

Only obtain the subset required by the chosen architecture:

1. Toncenter/RPC provider keys, stored server-side or behind a proxy.
2. Solana provider keys, if Solana remains enabled.
3. WalletConnect Project ID, if the active SDK path requires it. This ID is public.
4. WalletConnect Pay app/merchant credentials, if Pay remains enabled.
5. Telegram BotFather/bot credentials, stored outside frontend.
6. MFA server/auth credentials and private/master material.
7. Agent provider/LLM credentials for a self-hosted Agent backend.
8. Backend authentication/signing credentials.
9. Hostinger API token only for deployment automation; keep it in Replit Secrets with expiration and never put it in the frontend or repository.

### C. НУЖНО СОЗДАТЬ САМИМ

If the fork must be independent from My Wallet:

1. Backend/proxy implementing Brilliant-compatible request contracts or a planned frontend adapter migration.
2. TON RPC/indexer/streaming/emulation layer.
3. Token catalog, prices, metadata and scam-data service.
4. Swap aggregator/router/build/execute backend and provider integrations.
5. Staking catalog/state/profit backend and pool configuration.
6. Portfolio history/net-worth aggregation service.
7. Agent V2 backend, PostgreSQL, migrations and provider selection.
8. MFA backend, bot integration and compatible contract deployment.
9. Push notification backend/provider.
10. Owned static/image/CDN storage and image proxy.
11. TonConnect bridge, or an approved external bridge decision.
12. Telegram BotFather/Mini App configuration.
13. WalletConnect Cloud/Pay registration and origin allowlists if those features remain.
14. Production manifests for owned TonConnect DApps.

### D. МОЖНО НЕ УСТАНАВЛИВАТЬ

These are optional for a minimal TON wallet:

- Portfolio history;
- Agent;
- MFA;
- referrals/attribution;
- push notifications;
- swap;
- staking;
- WalletConnect Pay;
- multisend;
- giveaway functionality;
- WalletConnect if the current active path does not initialize it;
- Solana, Tron and EVM chains if the fork is TON-only;
- Statoscope and bundle comparison tooling;
- optional analytics;
- original promotional/card infrastructure, if corresponding UI is removed or intentionally left unavailable.

## 16. Recommended phased plan

### Phase 1 — basic wallet

- Decide whether original My Wallet APIs may remain.
- Provide compatible TON endpoints.
- Confirm balance, history, send, receive, Jettons and NFTs.
- Deploy ordinary web and Telegram builds separately.
- Verify CSP, HTTPS and manifests.

### Phase 2 — product services

- Replace/retain token catalog and prices.
- Implement/retain staking.
- Implement/retain swap.
- Implement/retain portfolio.
- Implement/retain notifications and attribution.

### Phase 3 — advanced integrations

- Agent backend.
- MFA backend and contract.
- WalletConnect/Pay registration.
- Multisend migration.
- CDN/static/image migration.

### Phase 4 — independence/security hardening

- Remove unowned `*.mywallet.io` and `*.mytonwallet.org` dependencies where replacements exist.
- Audit bundle/source maps/build logs for credentials.
- Narrow CSP and iframe allowlists.
- Add deploy smoke tests for the public HTTPS domain.
- Rotate/revoke temporary provider and deployment credentials.
# My Wallet fork — self-hosting requirements

Дата аудита: 2026-09-08  
Репозиторий: `https://github.com/Dimaosadchuk888/mytonwallet`  
Целевой домен: `https://mytonwallet.shop`

## 0. Границы аудита и итог

Этот документ создан как **read-only аудит инфраструктуры**. В рамках аудита:

- не изменялись wallet logic, UI, API-контракты или исходные конфигурации;
- не удалялись файлы;
- не добавлялись заглушки и не отключались функции ради подавления ошибок;
- исследовались исходники, build-конфигурация, внешние URL/API, Telegram Mini App, TON Connect, WalletConnect и feature-модули.

### Главный вывод

Проект является статическим frontend/SDK-приложением без backend-сервера в этом репозитории. Локальное создание ключей, импорт seed, подпись обычных транзакций и базовая wallet UI-логика находятся на клиенте. Но production-функциональность в текущем fork всё ещё зависит от исходной инфраструктуры My Wallet:

- `api.mywallet.io` и его `/proxy`;
- `*.mytonwallet.org` chain/API-прокси;
- `*.mywallet.io` для portfolio, Agent, multisend и других сервисов;
- `mfa.mytonwallet.io` и `mfa-server.mytonwallet.org`;
- TonConnect bridge и analytics;
- статические CDN/image-proxy сервисы.

Простое размещение `dist` на `mytonwallet.shop` не превращает fork в полностью независимый production-сервис. Для полноценного self-hosting нужно либо официально оставить и разрешить эти сервисы, либо создать совместимые backend/proxy/indexer/feature-сервисы.

## 1. Текущее состояние домена и деплоя

На момент аудита:

- `mytonwallet.shop` добавлен в Hostinger;
- static production build был загружен в Hostinger через Hostinger API;
- Hostinger API подтвердил наличие `index.html` и production-файлов в document root;
- HTTP перенаправляется на HTTPS, HTTPS отдаёт production HTML при проверке адресов Hostinger;
- DNS nameservers:

  ```text
  aurora.dns-parking.com
  nebula.dns-parking.com
  ```

- `www.mytonwallet.shop` обслуживается через Hostinger CDN.

Публичные DNS-резолверы во время миграции возвращали разные Hostinger A-адреса из-за кэширования/распространения записей. Все проверенные адреса Hostinger возвращали production `index.html` по HTTPS.

Для повторного деплоя в проекте добавлена команда:

```bash
npm run deploy:hostinger
```

Она использует `HOSTINGER_API_TOKEN` из Replit Secrets, собирает `dist`, добавляет SPA `.htaccess`, загружает архив через Hostinger API и запускает static deploy.

### Состояние Preview

Workflow `Start application` собирает production bundle и отдаёт его через Python static server на порту 5000. Preview показывает стартовый экран `MyTonWallet`.

## 2. Архитектура приложения

### Где находится backend

В репозитории не найдено отдельного production backend-сервера. Основные слои:

- Webpack frontend;
- Electron;
- Telegram Mini App;
- Air/mobile SDK;
- отдельные auxiliary builds: multisend, portfolio, push, MFA, explorer;
- внешние API/proxy и сторонние сервисы.

Переменные из `webpack.config.ts:465-526` внедряются через `EnvironmentPlugin`. Поэтому значения, переданные в web/Telegram/extension/SDK build, становятся доступными в собранном bundle. Это особенно важно для API keys: ключ, встроенный в frontend, уже нельзя считать секретом.

## 3. Environment variables

Классификация:

- **public/build** — значение попадает в frontend или влияет на сборку и должно считаться публичным;
- **secret** — credential/private data, которую нельзя передавать в публичную сборку;
- **runtime** — переменная окружения процесса/инструмента, не являющаяся конфигурацией wallet API;
- **test-only** — только для тестов и локальной автоматизации.

### 3.1 Canonical wallet configuration

Источник: `src/config.ts`.

| Переменная | Использование / default | Класс | Секрет |
|---|---|---|---|
| `APP_ENV` | Режим приложения, default `production`; также `src/portfolio/config.ts`, `src/multisend/config.ts` | build/frontend | Нет |
| `IS_GRAM_WALLET` | Выбор Gram branding, значение `1`/off | build flag | Нет |
| `APP_NAME` | Имя приложения, brand-dependent | public build | Нет |
| `APP_VERSION`, `APP_COMMIT_HASH` | Метаданные, внедряются Webpack | public build | Нет |
| `TEST_MNEMONIC`, `TEST_PASSWORD` | Test wallet; password default `test` | test-only | **Да** |
| `IS_EXTENSION`, `IS_FIREFOX_EXTENSION`, `IS_OPERA_EXTENSION` | Extension packaging | build flag | Нет |
| `IS_PACKAGED_ELECTRON` | Electron packaging | build flag | Нет |
| `IS_ANDROID_DIRECT`, `IS_AIR_APP` | Platform selection | build flag | Нет |
| `IS_TELEGRAM_APP` | Telegram Mini App mode | build flag | Нет |
| `IS_EXPLORER`, `IS_HEADLESS` | Auxiliary/headless builds | build flag | Нет |
| `BASE_URL` | Canonical/deployment URL, default `PRODUCTION_URL` | public build | Нет |
| `BOT_USERNAME` | Telegram bot username, default `MyTonWalletBot` | public frontend | Нет |
| `SWAP_FEE_ADDRESS`, `DIESEL_ADDRESS` | TON fee/payer contract addresses | public chain config | Нет |

### 3.4 What must never be embedded in frontend builds

Never put these into a public web, Telegram, extension, SDK or ordinary Electron distributable unless the credential is intentionally public and quota-only:

- Telegram bot token;
- backend authentication/signing credentials;
- MFA master/private credentials;
- WalletConnect Cloud secret/API credentials;
- WalletConnect Pay merchant credentials;
- `TONCENTER_*_KEY`;
- Electron Toncenter private keys;
- `SOLANA_*_API_KEY`;
- test mnemonic and passwords;
- any future provider key with privileged quota.

## 4. Build modes and exact commands

### Ordinary web

```bash
npm run dev
npm run build
npm run build:dev
npm run build:staging
npm run build:production
```

Plain `npm run build` is the current production-default Webpack build and then runs `deploy/copy_to_dist.sh`.

### Telegram Mini App

```bash
npm run telegram:dev
npm run telegram:build
npm run telegram:build:dev
npm run telegram:build:staging
npm run telegram:build:production
```

Production Telegram build must include:

```bash
IS_TELEGRAM_APP=1
APP_ENV=production
BASE_URL=https://mytonwallet.shop
BOT_USERNAME=<actual production bot username>
npm run telegram:build:production
```

The current Hostinger static deployment was made from the ordinary production build. It should not be treated as a fully configured Telegram Mini App until the Telegram build, bot settings, Telegram headers and origin configuration are verified.

### Other build modes

```bash
# Gram
npm run gram:build:production

# Extensions
npm run extension-chrome:package:production
npm run extension-firefox:package:production
npm run extension-opera:package:production

# Electron
npm run electron:package:staging
npm run electron:release:production

# Explorer
npm run explorer:build:production

# Air/mobile SDK
npm run mobile:build:production
npm run sdk:build:slim

# Auxiliary DApps/bundles
npm run multisend:build
npm run portfolio:build
npm run push:build
npm run mfa:build
```

Agent V2 checks/builds:

```bash
npm run contract:agent:v2:check
npm run test:agent:v2
npm run build:agent:v2:e2e
```

### 5.4 Original My Wallet infrastructure

The following namespaces are product-owned/original infrastructure, not neutral third-party endpoints:

```text
*.mywallet.io
*.mytonwallet.org
*.mytonwallet.io
```

This includes Brilliant backend/proxy, TON RPC/indexer proxies, Tron/Solana/EVM gateways, portfolio, Agent, MFA, static CDN, multisend and TonConnect bridge.

The fork must make an explicit decision for every such dependency:

1. retain it with permission and compatible production policy;
2. replace it with a self-hosted/owned service;
3. remove/disable the dependent feature;
4. keep it only as a temporary migration dependency.

## 6. `api.mywallet.io/referrer/get` call chain

The reported request failure is not the wallet key/custody path.

1. `createDirectApiConnector().initApi()` starts initialization in `src/api/providers/direct/connector.ts:22-28`.
2. `init()` starts polling, transfers, tokens, NFTs, MFA, staking, swap, optional Agent V2 and protocol services in `src/api/methods/init.ts:35-67`.
3. `saveReferrer()` uses an explicit `args.referrer`; otherwise it awaits `fetchBackendReferrer()` in `src/api/methods/init.ts:79-81`.
4. `fetchBackendReferrer()` calls `callBackendGet('/referrer/get')` in `src/api/common/backend.ts:86-88`.
5. The default full URL is `GET https://api.mywallet.io/referrer/get`.
6. `callBackendGet` uses the shared backend transport, app identity headers and retry/timeout behavior from `src/api/common/backend.ts:48-74`.
7. If a referrer is returned, it is persisted in storage under `referrer`, followed by client ID initialization.
8. A separate install-attribution chain calls `POST /attribution/claim` in `src/api/methods/attribution.ts:21-29,65-127`.
9. MFA has a separate query parameter chain: `?r=` is read in `src/mfa/runtime.ts:38-48`.

### Criticality

`/referrer/get` is optional attribution/client-ID initialization. It is not required for:

- local wallet creation;
- seed import;
- local key derivation;
- ordinary receive/address display;
- ordinary locally signed transaction flow, assuming chain APIs are available.

Other `api.mywallet.io` calls are more important: `/assets`, `/currency-rates`, swap, staking, portfolio, notifications and Agent can affect their respective features and loading states.

## 7. TON requirements

### Minimum for a usable TON wallet

1. Toncenter-compatible V3 wallet state endpoint.
2. Jetton wallet/balance endpoint.
3. Actions and pending actions.
4. Raw transactions.
5. NFT ownership/transfers and metadata support.
6. Message broadcast.
7. Transaction emulation.
8. WebSocket activity stream or reliable HTTP polling fallback.
9. Correct `X-Api-Key` and `X-Actions-Version` behavior where required.
10. CORS/CSP/rate limits compatible with browser clients, or an owned proxy.

### Feature mapping

| Function | Required chain service |
|---|---|
| TON balance | `/walletStates` |
| History | `/actions`, `/pendingActions`, `/transactions` |
| Send TON | Local signing + message broadcast; emulation for estimation |
| Receive TON | Local address/QR/invoice UI; indexer needed after receipt |
| Jettons | `/jetton/wallets`, metadata and token catalog |
| NFTs | NFT indexer, item/transfer endpoints, metadata/image gateway |
| Staking | On-chain contracts plus pool catalog/state/profit backend |
| Swap | Backend aggregator/router/build/execute plus chain services |
| Prices | Token catalog, market assets and currency rates backend |
| Emulation | `/api/emulate/v1/emulateTrace` or compatible service |

### Toncenter vs TonAPI

The current code is primarily built around Toncenter-compatible endpoints for wallet state, actions, transactions, NFT data, streaming and emulation. TonAPI-compatible configuration is present for supplemental capabilities/metadata.

They are not drop-in interchangeable solely by changing the base URL:

- response schemas and pagination may differ;
- action and transaction shapes must match the adapter expectations;
- WebSocket/streaming semantics must match;
- emulation endpoint and request format must match;
- headers and API-key behavior must match.

For an independent fork, choose one of:

- maintain a compatible Toncenter-facing proxy;
- adapt the chain modules to a selected provider;
- create an owned backend that normalizes Toncenter/TonAPI/provider responses.

## 8. Telegram Mini App

### Required application configuration

- Build with `IS_TELEGRAM_APP=1`.
- Build with `APP_ENV=production`.
- Set `BASE_URL=https://mytonwallet.shop`.
- Set `BOT_USERNAME` to the actual production bot username.
- Keep Telegram SDK from `https://telegram.org/js/telegram-web-app.js`.
- Preserve `window.Telegram.WebApp` initialization in `src/util/telegram/index.ts`.
- Do not put the Telegram bot token in frontend code.

### BotFather

The production bot must be configured externally:

- Main Mini App URL: `https://mytonwallet.shop`;
- menu button/Mini App URL must use HTTPS;
- bot username must match `BOT_USERNAME`;
- direct launches should use the correct `https://t.me/<bot>?startapp=...` form;
- test `?r=` and start parameters inside Telegram;
- verify Telegram WebApp, orientation, safe area, fullscreen, swipe and biometric behavior.

The repository does not configure BotFather remotely.

### Telegram headers and CSP

Telegram build uses `src/_headers_telegram`, while ordinary web uses `src/_headers`.

Telegram-specific requirements:

- preserve the Telegram CSP response header;
- preserve `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`;
- preserve Telegram framing policy;
- preserve `X-Robots-Tag: noindex`;
- preserve immutable/static asset caching where intended;
- serve CSP as an HTTP response header, not only the `<meta>` tag;
- do not deploy the ordinary `X-Frame-Options: Deny` header for the Telegram Mini App.

`src/_headers_telegram:1` contains a stale comment referring to `tma.mywallet.io`; this is a documentation/configuration gap, not proof that the runtime host is changed.

## 9. TON Connect

Current defaults:

- bridge: `https://tonconnectbridge.mytonwallet.org/bridge/`;
- analytics: `https://analytics.ton.org`;
- protocol v2;
- dApp manifest URL must be HTTPS and origin-consistent;
- multisend manifest currently declares `https://multisend.mywallet.io`.

Required production decisions:

1. Keep the original bridge/analytics with permission, or operate compatible replacements.
2. Host every owned manifest on HTTPS.
3. Keep manifest URL, declared origin and icon URL consistent.
4. Review CSP for bridge, analytics, manifest and icon origins.
5. Test injected/embedded wallet and universal-link flows inside Telegram.
6. If multisend is retained by the fork, migrate its domain and manifest together.

Telegram does not provide TonConnect bridge infrastructure by itself.

## 10. WalletConnect and WalletConnect Pay

### WalletConnect

`WALLET_CONNECT_PROJECT_ID` is read in `src/config.ts:172` and documented in `.env.example:23`. The audit did not find active `Core`/`SignClient` project-ID initialization in the current browser path.

Conclusion:

- Project ID is not demonstrably required by the current build;
- if a future SDK/relay path requires it, register `mytonwallet.shop` as a production origin;
- the Project ID is public;
- WalletConnect Cloud secrets/API credentials are not public and must stay server-side;
- retain only required relay origins in CSP.

### WalletConnect Pay

WalletConnect Pay is implemented in:

- `src/components/walletConnectPay/`;
- `src/api/methods/walletConnectPay.ts`;
- `src/global/actions/api/walletConnectPay.ts`;
- `src/util/walletConnectPay.ts`.

It depends on:

- `WALLET_CONNECT_PROJECT_ID`;
- `WALLET_CONNECT_PAY_APP_ID`;
- `api.pay.walletconnect.com`;
- `api.pay.walletconnect.org`;
- `pay.walletconnect.com`;
- registered Pay/merchant configuration;
- any merchant signing/API credentials kept server-side.

It is not fully self-hostable from this frontend repository.

## 11. Static assets and CDN

The application still references:

- `static.mytonwallet.org`;
- `imgproxy.mytonwallet.org`;
- `dns-image.mytonwallet.org`;
- original S3/update-feed hosts;
- TONAPI image/metadata hosts;
- `ipfs.io/ipfs/`;
- `cards.mytonwallet.io`;
- original promo/legal/blog/site assets.

### What happens if they are unavailable

- core wallet UI may open;
- token/NFT logos and metadata may be missing;
- cards and promotional sections may be broken;
- TON DNS image rendering may fail;
- desktop update checks may fail;
- CSP or image loading may block resources;
- optional features can remain in loading/error states.

Moving the visible site to `mytonwallet.shop` does not automatically migrate these assets. A self-hosted fork needs an explicit CDN/object-storage decision and CSP update.

## 13. Security requirements

### Never put in frontend

- Telegram bot tokens;
- backend auth tokens/signing secrets;
- MFA master/private keys;
- WalletConnect Cloud/API secrets;
- WalletConnect Pay merchant secrets;
- privileged RPC/API keys;
- test mnemonic/password;
- Hostinger API tokens.

### Public values

These are visible to users in bundles and are not secrets by themselves:

- deployment URL;
- bot username;
- API origins;
- WalletConnect Project ID;
- WalletConnect Pay App ID;
- fee/pool/contract addresses;
- feature flags;
- CSP origins.

Public does not mean trusted. Authorization, rate limiting and privileged operations must be enforced server-side.

### Headers and CSP

Review:

- `webpack.config.ts:82-167`;
- `src/_headers`;
- `src/_headers_telegram`;
- `src/index.html:20`.

The HTML CSP meta tag is not a substitute for the HTTP response header. Any Hostinger rewrite/static configuration must preserve the appropriate headers.

### Candidate values to migrate if `.shop` becomes canonical

- `PRODUCTION_URL` / `BASE_URL`;
- `BETA_URL` if a beta host is created;
- canonical headers in `webpack.config.ts:579-594`;
- HTML homepage/canonical metadata;
- install/site/icon/promo/legal/blog URLs;
- Telegram Mini App URL;
- owned multisend/portfolio/MFA hosts if actually recreated;
- TonConnect manifests and icon URLs;
- WalletConnect/Pay registered origins;
- BotFather configuration;
- CSP `frame-src`, `connect-src`, `img-src`;
- `IFRAME_WHITELIST` and `SUBPROJECT_URL_MASK`;
- deployment routing and TLS.

### Values not to replace casually

Do not replace these only because the visible website changed:

- blockchain RPC/indexer endpoints that remain external;
- TonConnect bridge/analytics if intentionally retained;
- protocol/deeplink schemes;
- contract/token/fee/pool addresses;
- `GLOBAL_STATE_CACHE_KEY`;
- `LEGACY_APP_HOSTS` unless legacy compatibility is intentionally retired;
- Gram-specific `wallet.ton.org` / `gramwallet.io` values when building My Wallet.

## 15. Final preparation lists

### A. ОБЯЗАТЕЛЬНО УСТАНОВИТЬ/НАСТРОИТЬ

For a basic independent TON wallet:

1. HTTPS hosting and DNS for `mytonwallet.shop`.
2. Production build with correct `BASE_URL`.
3. Compatible TON state, actions, transactions, jetton, NFT, broadcast and emulation services.
4. WebSocket stream or HTTP polling fallback.
5. CSP and security headers.
6. A decision on whether original My Wallet backend/proxy is retained.
7. Telegram Mini App build and BotFather setup if Telegram is a target.
8. Correct Telegram-specific headers for Telegram deployment.
9. Valid TonConnect manifest/origin if TON Connect is a target.
10. No privileged API keys embedded in public bundles.

For the current original-feature parity target, also:

11. Brilliant-compatible backend or a replacement for `/assets`, rates, swap, staking, portfolio, notifications, attribution and Agent.
12. Portfolio aggregation API.
13. Agent backend and provider infrastructure.
14. MFA server/bot/contract setup.
15. WalletConnect/Pay registration and origin policy where used.
16. Static/image/CDN ownership or an explicit decision to retain original services.

### B. НУЖНО ПОЛУЧИТЬ API KEYS / CREDENTIALS

Only obtain the subset required by the chosen architecture:

1. Toncenter/RPC provider keys, stored server-side or behind a proxy.
2. Solana provider keys, if Solana remains enabled.
3. WalletConnect Project ID, if the active SDK path requires it. This ID is public.
4. WalletConnect Pay app/merchant credentials, if Pay remains enabled.
5. Telegram BotFather/bot credentials, stored outside frontend.
6. MFA server/auth credentials and private/master material.
7. Agent provider/LLM credentials for a self-hosted Agent backend.
8. Backend authentication/signing credentials.
9. Hostinger API token only for deployment automation; keep it in Replit Secrets with expiration and never put it in the frontend or repository.

### C. НУЖНО СОЗДАТЬ САМИМ

If the fork must be independent from My Wallet:

1. Backend/proxy implementing Brilliant-compatible request contracts or a planned frontend adapter migration.
2. TON RPC/indexer/streaming/emulation layer.
3. Token catalog, prices, metadata and scam-data service.
4. Swap aggregator/router/build/execute backend and provider integrations.
5. Staking catalog/state/profit backend and pool configuration.
6. Portfolio history/net-worth aggregation service.
7. Agent V2 backend, PostgreSQL, migrations and provider selection.
8. MFA backend, bot integration and compatible contract deployment.
9. Push notification backend/provider.
10. Owned static/image/CDN storage and image proxy.
11. TonConnect bridge, or an approved external bridge decision.
12. Telegram BotFather/Mini App configuration.
13. WalletConnect Cloud/Pay registration and origin allowlists if those features remain.
14. Production manifests for owned TonConnect DApps.

### D. МОЖНО НЕ УСТАНАВЛИВАТЬ

These are optional for a minimal TON wallet:

- Portfolio history;
- Agent;
- MFA;
- referrals/attribution;
- push notifications;
- swap;
- staking;
- WalletConnect Pay;
- multisend;
- giveaway functionality;
- WalletConnect if the current active path does not initialize it;
- Solana, Tron and EVM chains if the fork is TON-only;
- Statoscope and bundle comparison tooling;
- optional analytics;
- original promotional/card infrastructure, if corresponding UI is removed or intentionally left unavailable.

## 16. Recommended phased plan

### Phase 1 — basic wallet

- Decide whether original My Wallet APIs may remain.
- Provide compatible TON endpoints.
- Confirm balance, history, send, receive, Jettons and NFTs.
- Deploy ordinary web and Telegram builds separately.
- Verify CSP, HTTPS and manifests.

### Phase 2 — product services

- Replace/retain token catalog and prices.
- Implement/retain staking.
- Implement/retain swap.
- Implement/retain portfolio.
- Implement/retain notifications and attribution.

### Phase 3 — advanced integrations

- Agent backend.
- MFA backend and contract.
- WalletConnect/Pay registration.
- Multisend migration.
- CDN/static/image migration.

### Phase 4 — independence/security hardening

- Remove unowned `*.mywallet.io` and `*.mytonwallet.org` dependencies where replacements exist.
- Audit bundle/source maps/build logs for credentials.
- Narrow CSP and iframe allowlists.
- Add deploy smoke tests for the public HTTPS domain.
- Rotate/revoke temporary provider and deployment credentials.
# My Wallet fork — self-hosting requirements

Дата аудита: 2026-09-08  
Репозиторий: `https://github.com/Dimaosadchuk888/mytonwallet`  
Целевой домен: `https://mytonwallet.shop`

## 0. Границы аудита и итог

Этот документ создан как **read-only аудит инфраструктуры**. В рамках аудита:

- не изменялись wallet logic, UI, API-контракты или исходные конфигурации;
- не удалялись файлы;
- не добавлялись заглушки и не отключались функции ради подавления ошибок;
- исследовались исходники, build-конфигурация, внешние URL/API, Telegram Mini App, TON Connect, WalletConnect и feature-модули.

### Главный вывод

Проект является статическим frontend/SDK-приложением без backend-сервера в этом репозитории. Локальное создание ключей, импорт seed, подпись обычных транзакций и базовая wallet UI-логика находятся на клиенте. Но production-функциональность в текущем fork всё ещё зависит от исходной инфраструктуры My Wallet:

- `api.mywallet.io` и его `/proxy`;
- `*.mytonwallet.org` chain/API-прокси;
- `*.mywallet.io` для portfolio, Agent, multisend и других сервисов;
- `mfa.mytonwallet.io` и `mfa-server.mytonwallet.org`;
- TonConnect bridge и analytics;
- статические CDN/image-proxy сервисы.

Простое размещение `dist` на `mytonwallet.shop` не превращает fork в полностью независимый production-сервис. Для полноценного self-hosting нужно либо официально оставить и разрешить эти сервисы, либо создать совместимые backend/proxy/indexer/feature-сервисы.

## 1. Текущее состояние домена и деплоя

На момент аудита:

- `mytonwallet.shop` добавлен в Hostinger;
- static production build был загружен в Hostinger через Hostinger API;
- Hostinger API подтвердил наличие `index.html` и production-файлов в document root;
- HTTP перенаправляется на HTTPS, HTTPS отдаёт production HTML при проверке адресов Hostinger;
- DNS nameservers:

  ```text
  aurora.dns-parking.com
  nebula.dns-parking.com
  ```

- `www.mytonwallet.shop` обслуживается через Hostinger CDN.

Публичные DNS-резолверы во время миграции возвращали разные Hostinger A-адреса из-за кэширования/распространения записей. Все проверенные адреса Hostinger возвращали production `index.html` по HTTPS.

Для повторного деплоя в проекте добавлена команда:

```bash
npm run deploy:hostinger
```

Она использует `HOSTINGER_API_TOKEN` из Replit Secrets, собирает `dist`, добавляет SPA `.htaccess`, загружает архив через Hostinger API и запускает static deploy.

### Состояние Preview

Workflow `Start application` собирает production bundle и отдаёт его через Python static server на порту 5000. Preview показывает стартовый экран `MyTonWallet`.

## 2. Архитектура приложения

### Где находится backend

В репозитории не найдено отдельного production backend-сервера. Основные слои:

- Webpack frontend;
- Electron;
- Telegram Mini App;
- Air/mobile SDK;
- отдельные auxiliary builds: multisend, portfolio, push, MFA, explorer;
- внешние API/proxy и сторонние сервисы.

Переменные из `webpack.config.ts:465-526` внедряются через `EnvironmentPlugin`. Поэтому значения, переданные в web/Telegram/extension/SDK build, становятся доступными в собранном bundle. Это особенно важно для API keys: ключ, встроенный в frontend, уже нельзя считать секретом.

## 3. Environment variables

Классификация:

- **public/build** — значение попадает в frontend или влияет на сборку и должно считаться публичным;
- **secret** — credential/private data, которую нельзя передавать в публичную сборку;
- **runtime** — переменная окружения процесса/инструмента, не являющаяся конфигурацией wallet API;
- **test-only** — только для тестов и локальной автоматизации.

### 3.4 What must never be embedded in frontend builds

Never put these into a public web, Telegram, extension, SDK or ordinary Electron distributable unless the credential is intentionally public and quota-only:

- Telegram bot token;
- backend authentication/signing credentials;
- MFA master/private credentials;
- WalletConnect Cloud secret/API credentials;
- WalletConnect Pay merchant credentials;
- `TONCENTER_*_KEY`;
- Electron Toncenter private keys;
- `SOLANA_*_API_KEY`;
- test mnemonic and passwords;
- any future provider key with privileged quota.

## 4. Build modes and exact commands

### Ordinary web

```bash
npm run dev
npm run build
npm run build:dev
npm run build:staging
npm run build:production
```

Plain `npm run build` is the current production-default Webpack build and then runs `deploy/copy_to_dist.sh`.

### Telegram Mini App

```bash
npm run telegram:dev
npm run telegram:build
npm run telegram:build:dev
npm run telegram:build:staging
npm run telegram:build:production
```

Production Telegram build must include:

```bash
IS_TELEGRAM_APP=1
APP_ENV=production
BASE_URL=https://mytonwallet.shop
BOT_USERNAME=<actual production bot username>
npm run telegram:build:production
```

The current Hostinger static deployment was made from the ordinary production build. It should not be treated as a fully configured Telegram Mini App until the Telegram build, bot settings, Telegram headers and origin configuration are verified.

### Other build modes

```bash
# Gram
npm run gram:build:production

# Extensions
npm run extension-chrome:package:production
npm run extension-firefox:package:production
npm run extension-opera:package:production

# Electron
npm run electron:package:staging
npm run electron:release:production

# Explorer
npm run explorer:build:production

# Air/mobile SDK
npm run mobile:build:production
npm run sdk:build:slim

# Auxiliary DApps/bundles
npm run multisend:build
npm run portfolio:build
npm run push:build
npm run mfa:build
```

Agent V2 checks/builds:

```bash
npm run contract:agent:v2:check
npm run test:agent:v2
npm run build:agent:v2:e2e
```

### 5.4 Original My Wallet infrastructure

The following namespaces are product-owned/original infrastructure, not neutral third-party endpoints:

```text
*.mywallet.io
*.mytonwallet.org
*.mytonwallet.io
```

This includes Brilliant backend/proxy, TON RPC/indexer proxies, Tron/Solana/EVM gateways, portfolio, Agent, MFA, static CDN, multisend and TonConnect bridge.

The fork must make an explicit decision for every such dependency:

1. retain it with permission and compatible production policy;
2. replace it with a self-hosted/owned service;
3. remove/disable the dependent feature;
4. keep it only as a temporary migration dependency.

## 6. `api.mywallet.io/referrer/get` call chain

The reported request failure is not the wallet key/custody path.

1. `createDirectApiConnector().initApi()` starts initialization in `src/api/providers/direct/connector.ts:22-28`.
2. `init()` starts polling, transfers, tokens, NFTs, MFA, staking, swap, optional Agent V2 and protocol services in `src/api/methods/init.ts:35-67`.
3. `saveReferrer()` uses an explicit `args.referrer`; otherwise it awaits `fetchBackendReferrer()` in `src/api/methods/init.ts:79-81`.
4. `fetchBackendReferrer()` calls `callBackendGet('/referrer/get')` in `src/api/common/backend.ts:86-88`.
5. The default full URL is `GET https://api.mywallet.io/referrer/get`.
6. `callBackendGet` uses the shared backend transport, app identity headers and retry/timeout behavior from `src/api/common/backend.ts:48-74`.
7. If a referrer is returned, it is persisted in storage under `referrer`, followed by client ID initialization.
8. A separate install-attribution chain calls `POST /attribution/claim` in `src/api/methods/attribution.ts:21-29,65-127`.
9. MFA has a separate query parameter chain: `?r=` is read in `src/mfa/runtime.ts:38-48`.

### Criticality

`/referrer/get` is optional attribution/client-ID initialization. It is not required for:

- local wallet creation;
- seed import;
- local key derivation;
- ordinary receive/address display;
- ordinary locally signed transaction flow, assuming chain APIs are available.

Other `api.mywallet.io` calls are more important: `/assets`, `/currency-rates`, swap, staking, portfolio, notifications and Agent can affect their respective features and loading states.

## 7. TON requirements

### Minimum for a usable TON wallet

1. Toncenter-compatible V3 wallet state endpoint.
2. Jetton wallet/balance endpoint.
3. Actions and pending actions.
4. Raw transactions.
5. NFT ownership/transfers and metadata support.
6. Message broadcast.
7. Transaction emulation.
8. WebSocket activity stream or reliable HTTP polling fallback.
9. Correct `X-Api-Key` and `X-Actions-Version` behavior where required.
10. CORS/CSP/rate limits compatible with browser clients, or an owned proxy.

### Feature mapping

| Function | Required chain service |
|---|---|
| TON balance | `/walletStates` |
| History | `/actions`, `/pendingActions`, `/transactions` |
| Send TON | Local signing + message broadcast; emulation for estimation |
| Receive TON | Local address/QR/invoice UI; indexer needed after receipt |
| Jettons | `/jetton/wallets`, metadata and token catalog |
| NFTs | NFT indexer, item/transfer endpoints, metadata/image gateway |
| Staking | On-chain contracts plus pool catalog/state/profit backend |
| Swap | Backend aggregator/router/build/execute plus chain services |
| Prices | Token catalog, market assets and currency rates backend |
| Emulation | `/api/emulate/v1/emulateTrace` or compatible service |

### Toncenter vs TonAPI

The current code is primarily built around Toncenter-compatible endpoints for wallet state, actions, transactions, NFT data, streaming and emulation. TonAPI-compatible configuration is present for supplemental capabilities/metadata.

They are not drop-in interchangeable solely by changing the base URL:

- response schemas and pagination may differ;
- action and transaction shapes must match the adapter expectations;
- WebSocket/streaming semantics must match;
- emulation endpoint and request format must match;
- headers and API-key behavior must match.

For an independent fork, choose one of:

- maintain a compatible Toncenter-facing proxy;
- adapt the chain modules to a selected provider;
- create an owned backend that normalizes Toncenter/TonAPI/provider responses.

## 8. Telegram Mini App

### Required application configuration

- Build with `IS_TELEGRAM_APP=1`.
- Build with `APP_ENV=production`.
- Set `BASE_URL=https://mytonwallet.shop`.
- Set `BOT_USERNAME` to the actual production bot username.
- Keep Telegram SDK from `https://telegram.org/js/telegram-web-app.js`.
- Preserve `window.Telegram.WebApp` initialization in `src/util/telegram/index.ts`.
- Do not put the Telegram bot token in frontend code.

### BotFather

The production bot must be configured externally:

- Main Mini App URL: `https://mytonwallet.shop`;
- menu button/Mini App URL must use HTTPS;
- bot username must match `BOT_USERNAME`;
- direct launches should use the correct `https://t.me/<bot>?startapp=...` form;
- test `?r=` and start parameters inside Telegram;
- verify Telegram WebApp, orientation, safe area, fullscreen, swipe and biometric behavior.

The repository does not configure BotFather remotely.

### Telegram headers and CSP

Telegram build uses `src/_headers_telegram`, while ordinary web uses `src/_headers`.

Telegram-specific requirements:

- preserve the Telegram CSP response header;
- preserve `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`;
- preserve Telegram framing policy;
- preserve `X-Robots-Tag: noindex`;
- preserve immutable/static asset caching where intended;
- serve CSP as an HTTP response header, not only the `<meta>` tag;
- do not deploy the ordinary `X-Frame-Options: Deny` header for the Telegram Mini App.

`src/_headers_telegram:1` contains a stale comment referring to `tma.mywallet.io`; this is a documentation/configuration gap, not proof that the runtime host is changed.

## 9. TON Connect

Current defaults:

- bridge: `https://tonconnectbridge.mytonwallet.org/bridge/`;
- analytics: `https://analytics.ton.org`;
- protocol v2;
- dApp manifest URL must be HTTPS and origin-consistent;
- multisend manifest currently declares `https://multisend.mywallet.io`.

Required production decisions:

1. Keep the original bridge/analytics with permission, or operate compatible replacements.
2. Host every owned manifest on HTTPS.
3. Keep manifest URL, declared origin and icon URL consistent.
4. Review CSP for bridge, analytics, manifest and icon origins.
5. Test injected/embedded wallet and universal-link flows inside Telegram.
6. If multisend is retained by the fork, migrate its domain and manifest together.

Telegram does not provide TonConnect bridge infrastructure by itself.

## 10. WalletConnect and WalletConnect Pay

### WalletConnect

`WALLET_CONNECT_PROJECT_ID` is read in `src/config.ts:172` and documented in `.env.example:23`. The audit did not find active `Core`/`SignClient` project-ID initialization in the current browser path.

Conclusion:

- Project ID is not demonstrably required by the current build;
- if a future SDK/relay path requires it, register `mytonwallet.shop` as a production origin;
- the Project ID is public;
- WalletConnect Cloud secrets/API credentials are not public and must stay server-side;
- retain only required relay origins in CSP.

### WalletConnect Pay

WalletConnect Pay is implemented in:

- `src/components/walletConnectPay/`;
- `src/api/methods/walletConnectPay.ts`;
- `src/global/actions/api/walletConnectPay.ts`;
- `src/util/walletConnectPay.ts`.

It depends on:

- `WALLET_CONNECT_PROJECT_ID`;
- `WALLET_CONNECT_PAY_APP_ID`;
- `api.pay.walletconnect.com`;
- `api.pay.walletconnect.org`;
- `pay.walletconnect.com`;
- registered Pay/merchant configuration;
- any merchant signing/API credentials kept server-side.

It is not fully self-hostable from this frontend repository.

## 11. Static assets and CDN

The application still references:

- `static.mytonwallet.org`;
- `imgproxy.mytonwallet.org`;
- `dns-image.mytonwallet.org`;
- original S3/update-feed hosts;
- TONAPI image/metadata hosts;
- `ipfs.io/ipfs/`;
- `cards.mytonwallet.io`;
- original promo/legal/blog/site assets.

### What happens if they are unavailable

- core wallet UI may open;
- token/NFT logos and metadata may be missing;
- cards and promotional sections may be broken;
- TON DNS image rendering may fail;
- desktop update checks may fail;
- CSP or image loading may block resources;
- optional features can remain in loading/error states.

Moving the visible site to `mytonwallet.shop` does not automatically migrate these assets. A self-hosted fork needs an explicit CDN/object-storage decision and CSP update.

## 12. Feature infrastructure matrix

| Функция | Работает сейчас в коде | Что отсутствует/зависит от внешних сервисов | Что нужно настроить | Критичность |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Запуск | Да, web/Telegram/Electron/SDK targets | Default API still original infrastructure | Compatible API endpoints, CSP and build values | CRITICAL |
| Создание кошелька | Да, local mnemonic/derivation | Initial balance needs chain API | TON RPC/indexer | CRITICAL |
| Импорт seed/private key/Ledger | Да | Account discovery/backend extras use chain/backend | Compatible chain API; Ledger build support | CRITICAL |
| Баланс TON | Да | Toncenter V3 `/walletStates` | Toncenter-compatible endpoint/key policy | CRITICAL |
| История | Да | Actions/transactions/socket | Indexer, WebSocket or polling | CRITICAL |
| Отправка TON | Да, local signing | Broadcast/emulation; gasless uses backend/payer | Broadcast, emulation; optional gasless backend | CRITICAL |
| Получение TON | Да, local address/QR/invoice | Balance after receipt needs indexer | Chain API | CRITICAL |
| Jettons | Да | Catalog, metadata, prices, scam data use backend | Toncenter-compatible jetton API and token catalog | IMPORTANT |
| NFT | Да | Indexer, metadata/image gateway and optional reporting | NFT API, IPFS/image strategy | IMPORTANT |
| Swap | UI and flow exist | Estimate/build/execute, routing/liquidity, auth backend | New aggregator/backend or retain Brilliant | IMPORTANT |
| Staking | Code exists but extra-feature gated | Pool catalog, state and profit backend | Pool config/contracts/backend | IMPORTANT |
| Token prices | Code exists | `/assets`, `/market/assets`, rates | Price/catalog provider or new backend | IMPORTANT |
| Emulation/estimation | TON/EVM/Solana modules exist | Provider-compatible emulation | Emulation endpoint and chain RPCs | IMPORTANT |
| Portfolio | UI/DApp exists | PnL/net-worth aggregation API | Portfolio API or replacement | OPTIONAL/IMPORTANT |
| TON Connect | Implemented | Bridge, analytics, manifests, CSP | Bridge/manifest/origin policy | IMPORTANT |
| WalletConnect | Adapters exist | Relay/project/origin policy; current Project ID use unclear | Confirm SDK path; register project if required | OPTIONAL/IMPORTANT |
| Telegram Mini App | Runtime/build exists | BotFather, Mini App URL, headers, bot settings | Telegram production configuration | IMPORTANT |
| Agent | V1/V2 surface exists | Agent backend, PostgreSQL, migrations, provider credentials | Self-host Agent backend or retain original | OPTIONAL |
| MFA | Code exists | MFA server, bot, contract, auth | MFA infrastructure or disable by explicit product decision | OPTIONAL/IMPORTANT |
| Referrals | Attribution chain exists | `/referrer/get`, `/attribution/claim` backend | Backend or accept loss of attribution | OPTIONAL |
| Notifications | Subscribe/unsubscribe UI exists | Backend push delivery and device token service | Notification backend/provider | OPTIONAL |
| Giveaway | No implementation found | No source feature/API found | Separate product implementation if required | OUT OF SCOPE |
| Multisend | Separate DApp/build exists | TonConnect, manifests, chain/indexer | Own/retain multisend host and manifest | OPTIONAL/IMPORTANT |
| WalletConnect Pay | UI/protocol flow exists | Pay API, app/merchant config, credentials | WalletConnect Pay account/origins | OPTIONAL |

## 13. Security requirements

### Never put in frontend

- Telegram bot tokens;
- backend auth tokens/signing secrets;
- MFA master/private keys;
- WalletConnect Cloud/API secrets;
- WalletConnect Pay merchant secrets;
- privileged RPC/API keys;
- test mnemonic/password;
- Hostinger API tokens.

### Public values

These are visible to users in bundles and are not secrets by themselves:

- deployment URL;
- bot username;
- API origins;
- WalletConnect Project ID;
- WalletConnect Pay App ID;
- fee/pool/contract addresses;
- feature flags;
- CSP origins.

Public does not mean trusted. Authorization, rate limiting and privileged operations must be enforced server-side.

### Headers and CSP

Review:

- `webpack.config.ts:82-167`;
- `src/_headers`;
- `src/_headers_telegram`;
- `src/index.html:20`.

The HTML CSP meta tag is not a substitute for the HTTP response header. Any Hostinger rewrite/static configuration must preserve the appropriate headers.

## 14. Domain migration map

### Candidate values to migrate if `.shop` becomes canonical

- `PRODUCTION_URL` / `BASE_URL`;
- `BETA_URL` if a beta host is created;
- canonical headers in `webpack.config.ts:579-594`;
- HTML homepage/canonical metadata;
- install/site/icon/promo/legal/blog URLs;
- Telegram Mini App URL;
- owned multisend/portfolio/MFA hosts if actually recreated;
- TonConnect manifests and icon URLs;
- WalletConnect/Pay registered origins;
- BotFather configuration;
- CSP `frame-src`, `connect-src`, `img-src`;
- `IFRAME_WHITELIST` and `SUBPROJECT_URL_MASK`;
- deployment routing and TLS.

### Values not to replace casually

Do not replace these only because the visible website changed:

- blockchain RPC/indexer endpoints that remain external;
- TonConnect bridge/analytics if intentionally retained;
- protocol/deeplink schemes;
- contract/token/fee/pool addresses;
- `GLOBAL_STATE_CACHE_KEY`;
- `LEGACY_APP_HOSTS` unless legacy compatibility is intentionally retired;
- Gram-specific `wallet.ton.org` / `gramwallet.io` values when building My Wallet.

## 15. Final preparation lists

### A. ОБЯЗАТЕЛЬНО УСТАНОВИТЬ/НАСТРОИТЬ

For a basic independent TON wallet:

1. HTTPS hosting and DNS for `mytonwallet.shop`.
2. Production build with correct `BASE_URL`.
3. Compatible TON state, actions, transactions, jetton, NFT, broadcast and emulation services.
4. WebSocket stream or HTTP polling fallback.
5. CSP and security headers.
6. A decision on whether original My Wallet backend/proxy is retained.
7. Telegram Mini App build and BotFather setup if Telegram is a target.
8. Correct Telegram-specific headers for Telegram deployment.
9. Valid TonConnect manifest/origin if TON Connect is a target.
10. No privileged API keys embedded in public bundles.

For the current original-feature parity target, also:

11. Brilliant-compatible backend or a replacement for `/assets`, rates, swap, staking, portfolio, notifications, attribution and Agent.
12. Portfolio aggregation API.
13. Agent backend and provider infrastructure.
14. MFA server/bot/contract setup.
15. WalletConnect/Pay registration and origin policy where used.
16. Static/image/CDN ownership or an explicit decision to retain original services.

### B. НУЖНО ПОЛУЧИТЬ API KEYS / CREDENTIALS

Only obtain the subset required by the chosen architecture:

1. Toncenter/RPC provider keys, stored server-side or behind a proxy.
2. Solana provider keys, if Solana remains enabled.
3. WalletConnect Project ID, if the active SDK path requires it. This ID is public.
4. WalletConnect Pay app/merchant credentials, if Pay remains enabled.
5. Telegram BotFather/bot credentials, stored outside frontend.
6. MFA server/auth credentials and private/master material.
7. Agent provider/LLM credentials for a self-hosted Agent backend.
8. Backend authentication/signing credentials.
9. Hostinger API token only for deployment automation; keep it in Replit Secrets with expiration and never put it in the frontend or repository.

### C. НУЖНО СОЗДАТЬ САМИМ

If the fork must be independent from My Wallet:

1. Backend/proxy implementing Brilliant-compatible request contracts or a planned frontend adapter migration.
2. TON RPC/indexer/streaming/emulation layer.
3. Token catalog, prices, metadata and scam-data service.
4. Swap aggregator/router/build/execute backend and provider integrations.
5. Staking catalog/state/profit backend and pool configuration.
6. Portfolio history/net-worth aggregation service.
7. Agent V2 backend, PostgreSQL, migrations and provider selection.
8. MFA backend, bot integration and compatible contract deployment.
9. Push notification backend/provider.
10. Owned static/image/CDN storage and image proxy.
11. TonConnect bridge, or an approved external bridge decision.
12. Telegram BotFather/Mini App configuration.
13. WalletConnect Cloud/Pay registration and origin allowlists if those features remain.
14. Production manifests for owned TonConnect DApps.

### D. МОЖНО НЕ УСТАНАВЛИВАТЬ

These are optional for a minimal TON wallet:

- Portfolio history;
- Agent;
- MFA;
- referrals/attribution;
- push notifications;
- swap;
- staking;
- WalletConnect Pay;
- multisend;
- giveaway functionality;
- WalletConnect if the current active path does not initialize it;
- Solana, Tron and EVM chains if the fork is TON-only;
- Statoscope and bundle comparison tooling;
- optional analytics;
- original promotional/card infrastructure, if corresponding UI is removed or intentionally left unavailable.

## 16. Recommended phased plan

### Phase 1 — basic wallet

- Decide whether original My Wallet APIs may remain.
- Provide compatible TON endpoints.
- Confirm balance, history, send, receive, Jettons and NFTs.
- Deploy ordinary web and Telegram builds separately.
- Verify CSP, HTTPS and manifests.

### Phase 2 — product services

- Replace/retain token catalog and prices.
- Implement/retain staking.
- Implement/retain swap.
- Implement/retain portfolio.
- Implement/retain notifications and attribution.

### Phase 3 — advanced integrations

- Agent backend.
- MFA backend and contract.
- WalletConnect/Pay registration.
- Multisend migration.
- CDN/static/image migration.

### Phase 4 — independence/security hardening

- Remove unowned `*.mywallet.io` and `*.mytonwallet.org` dependencies where replacements exist.
- Audit bundle/source maps/build logs for credentials.
- Narrow CSP and iframe allowlists.
- Add deploy smoke tests for the public HTTPS domain.
- Rotate/revoke temporary provider and deployment credentials.
# My Wallet fork — self-hosting requirements

Дата аудита: 2026-09-08  
Репозиторий: `https://github.com/Dimaosadchuk888/mytonwallet`  
Целевой домен: `https://mytonwallet.shop`

## 0. Границы аудита и итог

Этот документ создан как **read-only аудит инфраструктуры**. В рамках аудита:

- не изменялись wallet logic, UI, API-контракты или исходные конфигурации;
- не удалялись файлы;
- не добавлялись заглушки и не отключались функции ради подавления ошибок;
- исследовались исходники, build-конфигурация, внешние URL/API, Telegram Mini App, TON Connect, WalletConnect и feature-модули.

### Главный вывод

Проект является статическим frontend/SDK-приложением без backend-сервера в этом репозитории. Локальное создание ключей, импорт seed, подпись обычных транзакций и базовая wallet UI-логика находятся на клиенте. Но production-функциональность в текущем fork всё ещё зависит от исходной инфраструктуры My Wallet:

- `api.mywallet.io` и его `/proxy`;
- `*.mytonwallet.org` chain/API-прокси;
- `*.mywallet.io` для portfolio, Agent, multisend и других сервисов;
- `mfa.mytonwallet.io` и `mfa-server.mytonwallet.org`;
- TonConnect bridge и analytics;
- статические CDN/image-proxy сервисы.

Простое размещение `dist` на `mytonwallet.shop` не превращает fork в полностью независимый production-сервис. Для полноценного self-hosting нужно либо официально оставить и разрешить эти сервисы, либо создать совместимые backend/proxy/indexer/feature-сервисы.

## 1. Текущее состояние домена и деплоя

На момент аудита:

- `mytonwallet.shop` добавлен в Hostinger;
- static production build был загружен в Hostinger через Hostinger API;
- Hostinger API подтвердил наличие `index.html` и production-файлов в document root;
- HTTP перенаправляется на HTTPS, HTTPS отдаёт production HTML при проверке адресов Hostinger;
- DNS nameservers:

  ```text
  aurora.dns-parking.com
  nebula.dns-parking.com
  ```

- `www.mytonwallet.shop` обслуживается через Hostinger CDN.

Публичные DNS-резолверы во время миграции возвращали разные Hostinger A-адреса из-за кэширования/распространения записей. Все проверенные адреса Hostinger возвращали production `index.html` по HTTPS.

Для повторного деплоя в проекте добавлена команда:

```bash
npm run deploy:hostinger
```

Она использует `HOSTINGER_API_TOKEN` из Replit Secrets, собирает `dist`, добавляет SPA `.htaccess`, загружает архив через Hostinger API и запускает static deploy.

### Состояние Preview

Workflow `Start application` собирает production bundle и отдаёт его через Python static server на порту 5000. Preview показывает стартовый экран `MyTonWallet`.

## 2. Архитектура приложения

### Где находится backend

В репозитории не найдено отдельного production backend-сервера. Основные слои:

- Webpack frontend;
- Electron;
- Telegram Mini App;
- Air/mobile SDK;
- отдельные auxiliary builds: multisend, portfolio, push, MFA, explorer;
- внешние API/proxy и сторонние сервисы.

Переменные из `webpack.config.ts:465-526` внедряются через `EnvironmentPlugin`. Поэтому значения, переданные в web/Telegram/extension/SDK build, становятся доступными в собранном bundle. Это особенно важно для API keys: ключ, встроенный в frontend, уже нельзя считать секретом.

## 3. Environment variables

Классификация:

- **public/build** — значение попадает в frontend или влияет на сборку и должно считаться публичным;
- **secret** — credential/private data, которую нельзя передавать в публичную сборку;
- **runtime** — переменная окружения процесса/инструмента, не являющаяся конфигурацией wallet API;
- **test-only** — только для тестов и локальной автоматизации.

### 3.1 Canonical wallet configuration

Источник: `src/config.ts`.

| Переменная | Использование / default | Класс | Секрет |

### 3.4 What must never be embedded in frontend builds

Never put these into a public web, Telegram, extension, SDK or ordinary Electron distributable unless the credential is intentionally public and quota-only:

- Telegram bot token;
- backend authentication/signing credentials;
- MFA master/private credentials;
- WalletConnect Cloud secret/API credentials;
- WalletConnect Pay merchant credentials;
- `TONCENTER_*_KEY`;
- Electron Toncenter private keys;
- `SOLANA_*_API_KEY`;
- test mnemonic and passwords;
- any future provider key with privileged quota.

## 4. Build modes and exact commands

### Ordinary web

```bash
npm run dev
npm run build
npm run build:dev
npm run build:staging
npm run build:production
```

Plain `npm run build` is the current production-default Webpack build and then runs `deploy/copy_to_dist.sh`.

### Telegram Mini App

```bash
npm run telegram:dev
npm run telegram:build
npm run telegram:build:dev
npm run telegram:build:staging
npm run telegram:build:production
```

Production Telegram build must include:

```bash
IS_TELEGRAM_APP=1
APP_ENV=production
BASE_URL=https://mytonwallet.shop
BOT_USERNAME=<actual production bot username>
npm run telegram:build:production
```

The current Hostinger static deployment was made from the ordinary production build. It should not be treated as a fully configured Telegram Mini App until the Telegram build, bot settings, Telegram headers and origin configuration are verified.

### Other build modes

```bash
# Gram
npm run gram:build:production

# Extensions
npm run extension-chrome:package:production
npm run extension-firefox:package:production
npm run extension-opera:package:production

# Electron
npm run electron:package:staging
npm run electron:release:production

# Explorer
npm run explorer:build:production

# Air/mobile SDK
npm run mobile:build:production
npm run sdk:build:slim

# Auxiliary DApps/bundles
npm run multisend:build
npm run portfolio:build
npm run push:build
npm run mfa:build
```

Agent V2 checks/builds:

```bash
npm run contract:agent:v2:check
npm run test:agent:v2
npm run build:agent:v2:e2e
```
